_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate (only 24% of windows move ±2) plus neutral F&G and intact long-term structure favor drift into Complacency rather than a directional break.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicitly HOLD to Complacency; narrative implies mild constructive bias but supplies no phase/direction call
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 45-55, 30d momentum stays roughly -8% to +5%, ETF flows remain dead, no vol spike
next_move.invalidated_if: fast flush with F&G under 35 and funding negative, or ETF flows reverse hard with momentum turning positive
